<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$pages = array(
  array('title' => 'Home', 'slug' => 'home', 'template' => 'front-page.php'),
  array('title' => 'Services', 'slug' => 'services', 'template' => 'page-services.php'),
  array('title' => 'Orthodontics', 'slug' => 'orthodontics', 'template' => 'page-orthodontics.php'),
  array('title' => 'New Patients', 'slug' => 'new-patients', 'template' => 'page-new-patients.php'),
  array('title' => 'Team', 'slug' => 'team', 'template' => 'page-team.php'),
  array('title' => 'About', 'slug' => 'about', 'template' => 'page-about.php'),
  array('title' => 'Emergency', 'slug' => 'emergency', 'template' => 'page-emergency.php'),
  array('title' => 'Book', 'slug' => 'book', 'template' => 'page-book.php'),
);

$home_id = 0;
foreach ($pages as $p) {
  $id = wp_insert_post(array(
    'post_title'   => $p['title'],
    'post_name'    => $p['slug'],
    'post_status'  => 'publish',
    'post_type'    => 'page',
    'post_content' => '',
  ));
  if (!is_wp_error($id) && $p['template'] !== 'front-page.php') {
    update_post_meta($id, '_wp_page_template', $p['template']);
  }
  if ($p['slug'] === 'home') {
    $home_id = $id;
  }
}

update_option('show_on_front', 'page');
update_option('page_on_front', $home_id);
update_option('permalink_structure', '/%postname%/');
flush_rewrite_rules();
